method: Manual comparison against public CurseForge modpack result pages surfaced for Verity Pack, VERITY.exe, Falsity, and Verity Mod searches. Download totals are point-in-time popularity signals, not safety verdicts.

modpacks.name: VERITY.exe
modpacks.sourceNote: Current CurseForge project route for VERITY.exe. Main file is Forge Port 2.1.2 for Minecraft 1.20.1, uploaded July 28, 2026; the older visible NeoForge 1.3.3 file is record 8385443, and the project description says voice chat and direct chat are supported while Groq issues are outside the pack author's control.

modpacks.name: Verity Pack
modpacks.sourceNote: The public result text says this modpack does not contain the Verity mod and that the player needs to add it separately.

modpacks.name: VerityPack
modpacks.sourceNote: A separate CurseForge modpack route and not the same artifact as Verity JE or Bedrock add-ons.

modpacks.name: VerityPack Realistic
modpacks.sourceNote: A separate realistic profile result; not proof that the standalone Verity JE file is installed.

modpacks.name: Survive from VERITY or FALSITY
modpacks.sourceNote: Separate CurseForge modpack route for users searching Verity or Falsity together. Treat it as a profile route, not as the standalone FALSITY [SMILEY] mod, Verity JE Java file, Verity BE, or PnTMC Bedrock file.

routePolicy: Use modpack pages only when the player intentionally wants that profile. Use /falsity-mod/ for the standalone FALSITY [SMILEY] route, Verity JE for the standalone Java Verity JAR, and Bedrock or MCPE pages for MCADDON routes. This site does not host or mirror files.
